title: Crypto faces $3.63 billion security crisis despite audited protocols — Details
summary: Why is crypto insurance coverage falling despite a rise in the frequency of hacks?
content: The cryptocurrency sector is currently facing a significant security crisis, with billions in losses reported despite the widespread use of audited protocols. This growing disparity has raised serious questions across the industry, particularly regarding why crypto insurance coverage continues to fall even as the frequency of hacks and security breaches rises.
